alternative_receiver_comparison.interpretation: Seven receiver choices per matched case means the screen baseline plus six alternatives. These are conditional noise draws on four fixed physical paths, not independent channel trials. Raw bit errors, wrong accepted bits, misses, null false admissions and noise-draw counts remain separate. No pooled confidence interval or new-channel claim is made.

global_limits: All receiver outcome counts in the 5x alternative matrix are conditional noise draws on matched, reused development physical paths; do not treat the 16 noise replicates per path as independent channel trials.
Precision/device timing runs used identical inputs and noise RNG schedules, but their shared-resource wall times are not a GPU acceleration benchmark.
The 850-day rows are simulator-produced sufficient statistics and cannot establish continuous 850-day field reception, reliability or false-admission behavior.
No default receiver, duration planner, channel model or operational probability target is changed by this descriptive comparison.

long_duration_block_refinement.scope: Compressed simulator sufficient-statistics observations at one requested 850-day duration; neither a continuous field observation nor an 850-day reception qualification.
long_duration_block_refinement.source_hash_scope: The refinement audit records complete per-file SHA-256 receipts for parent/refined exports. Raw retained arrays were not included in the local evidence snapshot, so those receipts were not rehashed here.

precision_device_benchmark.interpretation: Same input hash receipts and RNG schedule were confirmed. Rank/gate agreement and score deltas are measured on these exact arrays. Timings were contended and are not an acceleration claim or a representative isolated hardware benchmark.
